speaches_holdout.scope_limit: Pinned public decorators plus local operations; not the complete Speaches service or a deployment.

uipath_holdout.scope_limit: Complete pinned public source file with local metadata/context dependency seams; not the complete UiPath package, product, or deployment.

uipath_local_correction.scope_limit: Complete pinned public source file with local metadata/context dependency seams; not the complete UiPath package, product, or deployment.

native_mutation_matrix.classification: Bounded test-sensitivity matrix over synthetic executable operators; not repository-wide mutation testing or defect prevalence.

gate_ablation.interpretation: Removing any tested gate converts boundedly insufficient evidence into a definite CI action. Counts describe this retained challenge set only; they are not precision/recall estimates.

mutation_challenge.interpretation: Oracle mutation analysis over retained real SDK traces; not additional software defects or independent application runs.

policy_counterfactual.interpretation: The same trace evidence can be valid for one declared role and invalid or undecidable for another; this does not rank the roles.

independent_replay.interpretation: The seven verdict changes are pass/fail-to-inconclusive or the reverse and all involve clock qualification; no pass/fail reversal occurred.

executable_perturbations.classification: Synthetic executable challenge operators; not upstream defects or application bug prevalence.

topology_challenge.classification: Executable contract-topology and correlation challenge. Fault cases are controlled operators, not upstream defect or prevalence claims.
